scope: Selected f6 refit weights, meta booster, direct assembly inputs and feature-store copies. No raw tables or weights are redistributed in this repository.
gaps: Any model marked verified_retention=false still needs a verified private weights bank.
Feature-store copies marked verified=false have a creation acknowledgement but still require every version-1 file checksum to be verified.
fs6/fs7 native copies omit the generated __output__.json metadata recorded by some refit identities.
Legacy A/B and month-out upstream trained models have no complete retained-weight audit.
Original ADS-B daily release asset receipts and extraction-output banks remain incomplete.
The exact producing kernel version is not established for every local or Colab output.
Assembly replay starts from retained predictions; a fresh complete training drill has not been certified.
